Guruvayur Ulsavam 2026: Complete Festival Schedule, Rituals, Kodiyettam & Arattu Details

By Guruvayur Live Editorial • Published on 2026-03-03

Guruvayur Ulsavam 2026 – Complete Festival Schedule, Rituals & Highlights

Guruvayur Ulsavam The famous annual festival of Guruvayur Temple, Guruvayur Ulsavam 2026, will be celebrated with immense devotion and traditional splendor from February 20 to March 9, 2026. The nine-day festival is one of the most important temple celebrations in Kerala, drawing thousands of devotees, artists, and visitors to Guruvayur.

The Guruvayur Ulsavam is one of the beautiful blends of sacred temple rituals, majestic elephant processions, traditional melam, classical art performances, and the spiritually significant Aarattu ceremony.

Kalavara Nirakkal – The Ritual Preparations (Feb 20 – Feb 27, 2026)

The celebrations started  with Kalavara Nirakkal, a traditional ritual marking the ceremonial preparation for the festival. During these days:

  • Special poojas are conducted.
  • Offerings are arranged in the temple store (Kalavara)
  • Devotees participate in sacred rituals.
  • Temple premises begin festive decorations.
  •  

These preparatory days build spiritual anticipation among devotees.

Kodiyettam – Official Beginning of Ulsavam (March 1, 2026)

In the Guruvayur Ulsavam the most awaited moment, Kodiyettam (flag hoisting), marks the official starting of Guruvayur Ulsavam. The ceremonial flag is hoisted in the temple premises amidst Vedic chants and devotional music.

From that moment, the temple atmosphere transforms into a vibrant spiritual festival ground.

Daily Rituals During Ulsavam

In Guruvayur Ulsavam, each day begins early morning with traditional temple rituals including:

  • Nirmalyam
  • Abhishekam
  • Usha Pooja
  • Pantheeradi Pooja
  • Seeveli (procession inside temple)

In Guruvayur Ulsavam, you can see the rhythmic beats of chenda and traditional instruments accompany the Seeveli, where beautiful elephants add grandeur to the ritual.

Evening rituals and deepa-alankaram create a mesmerizing devotional experience for devotees.

Cultural Programs & Artistic Celebrations

One of the biggest highlights in  Guruvayur Ulsavam 2026 is the wide variety of cultural programs organized every day.

Across the festival days, devotees can witness:

  • Classical dance performances like Bharatanatyam and Mohiniyattam
  • Kathakali performances
  • Carnatic music concerts
  • Devotional singing programs
  • Bhajans and Sopana Sangeetham
  • Instrumental concerts
  • Drama and traditional art presentations

Renowned artists, upcoming talents, and cultural groups participate in these programs, making the evenings lively and spiritually enriching.

Children’s performances and group dance presentations also add energy and enthusiasm to the festival.

Special Highlights (March 7 – March 9, 2026)

The final days of the Ulsavam are especially grand.

Ulsavam Day 8 (March 7 – Saturday)
  • Special Seeveli
  • Devotional performances
  • Evening cultural programs
  • Temple rituals with large devotee participation
Ulsavam Day 9 (March 8 – Sunday)
  • Extended temple rituals
  • Pallivetta (symbolic royal hunt ritual)
  • Cultural programs and devotional gatherings
Ulsavam Day 10 (March 9 – Monday) – Aarattu Day

The last days of festival includes with the sacred Aarattu ceremony, where the idol of Lord Guruvayurappan is ceremonially taken for the holy bath. This ritual symbolizes purification and the formal conclusion of the festival.

Devotees gather in huge numbers to witness Aarattu, considering it highly auspicious.

Elephant Procession & Melam

The presence of beautifully decorated elephants during Seeveli is one of the most iconic aspects of Guruvayur Ulsavam. The traditional melam featuring chenda, ilathalam, kombu, and kuzhal creates a divine and energetic atmosphere within the temple premises.

The synchronized rhythm of percussion instruments and the visual grandeur of elephants carrying the deity make the festival unforgettable.

Spiritual & Cultural Significance

Guruvayur Ulsavam is not just a temple festival—it is a celebration of faith, culture, and Kerala’s rich artistic heritage.

For devotees, it is a time to seek blessings of Lord Guruvayurappan.

For artists, it is a prestigious platform to perform.

For visitors, it is an opportunity to experience the true essence of Kerala’s temple traditions.

The entire town of Guruvayur comes alive during Ulsavam, filled with devotion, music, lamps, and festive energy.

Plan Your Visit

If you are planning to visit Guruvayur during Ulsavam 2026:

  • Arrive early for morning rituals
  • Expect heavy crowds during Kodiyettam and Aarattu
  • Attend evening cultural programs for a complete festival experience
  • Follow temple dress code and guidelines

Guruvayur Ulsavam 2026 promises nine days of devotion, tradition, and grand celebration. Whether you are a devotee or a lover of classical arts, this festival offers a spiritually uplifting and culturally rich experience.

Stay tuned to Guruvayur Live for daily updates and detailed schedules of Guruvayur Ulsavam 2026.
